strategy.overview: Hang-On begins with a choice of circuit 1, 2, or 3. Follow the lit circuit and complete its Loop before the race time expires; finishing a circuit awards a replay, and completing all three can award four replays. The H-A-N-G targets prepare Extra Ball, while the O-N targets raise the end-of-ball bonus multiplier. Faster settings shorten the available race time, so the circuit route matters more than unrelated scoring.
strategy.simpleOverview: Select circuit 1, 2, or 3 at the start, then follow that circuit and complete its Loop before race time expires. Complete H-A-N-G to prepare Extra Ball and O-N to raise Bonus X. Finish all three circuits for the largest replay award.
strategy.summary: Choose the circuit with the clearest return path, complete its Loop before taking side objectives, then use H-A-N-G for survival or O-N for Bonus X between circuit attempts.

quickInfo.name: Finish the Race
quickInfo.summary: Complete the selected circuit and its Loop.

steps.text: At the start, select circuit 1, 2, or 3 and identify its lit route before plunging.
Follow the selected circuit and make its Loop before the race timer expires.
Repeat with the remaining circuits; one completed circuit awards a replay, while all three can award four replays.
Complete H-A-N-G when Extra Ball matters more than race progress, or complete O-N to raise Bonus X.

alternatives.title: Survival route
alternatives.when: Use this when the chosen circuit is rejecting shots or the timer is already too low.

steps.text: Complete the four H-A-N-G targets to prepare Extra Ball.
Return to circuit play on the next controlled ball rather than forcing a late Loop shot.
Complete each selected circuit and its Loop within the available race time.
Finish circuits 1, 2, and 3 for the machine's four-replay award setting.

machineSetup: Confirm the circuit-selection control, race-time setting, replay and Extra Ball awards, and whether the location permits the factory multi-replay values.
Test the three circuit lamps, Loop switches, H-A-N-G and O-N targets, Bonus X lamps, outlane saves, and all playfield switches shown in the operator diagrams.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use small, early nudges to keep a timed circuit return out of the side lanes; a saved ball is worth more than an uncontrolled flip while race time remains.

cautions.issue: Race time and the replay-heavy factory awards can differ substantially by setup.
cautions.response: Confirm the timer and award configuration before choosing a circuit or treating a completed race as an Extra Ball route.
